saveFormat.v5LotModel: lot = anchor index + 1 on every cell; anchor stage = size 1..3; cells mirror stage and buildingState
saveFormat.v4ToV5Migration: per-tile buildings grouped into lots by the v4 grouping rule; isolated tiles become 1x1 lots; funds unchanged
saveFormat.ruleset5ToRuleset6Migration: no-op: restamps payload.rulesetVersion and engine.rulesetVersion from 5 to 6; formatVersion and the payload version stay 5 because no field is required: avenue is optional and absent from every ruleset-5 city; every other byte of the city is unchanged

lotCapacityBySize.comment: residents (r) or jobs (c, i) of a lot before its tier multiplier (lotTiers)

lotTiers.comment: land value picks a lot's look when it is built: under tierLow low, under the city's tower line middle, else high. The tower line is the land value the dearest downtownShare of dry land reaches, never below tierHigh; only a lot with a road along a side reaches the high tier (towers on 2x2 and 3x3), and each towerValueStep over the line is one of the eight high variants taller. A working lot whose land rises over the line, or a tower whose land rises two steps, is rebuilt with redevelopChance per look while its zone has demand; every tier runs at the same capacity multiplier

roadReach.comment: every building stands on a street: a lot works only while a street tile (road, bridge or onramp, never a highway) lies along its footprint; an airport or seaport tile works within the port reach of one

powerDeclineChance.comment: per four-day look at a dark working lot; powerFuseDays in the dark is certain decline

disasterCauses.firestorm: burns a radius of 12, not the whole map

ruleset6.decision: owner directive, 2026-10-02: 「地铁过水同意放开，按推荐 A 做」 (internal/plans/BASIN-WORLD.zh-CN.md, 待拍板 #3, recommendation A)

underwaterSubway.comment: a subway line may cross water tiles as a tunnel under the bed: the same subway layer, the same commute graph, the same monthly subway upkeep per tile; only the build price differs. Demolish never touches the subway layer, on land or under water, and nothing is refunded; undo restores the funds of the transaction

exports.sc2: subway and water both survive the round trip: XUND carries the subway piece and XTER the water under it, two independent segments
exports.micropolis: the subway is dropped like every subway and counted in layer-dropped-subway; the tile exports as water

avenue.decision: Aaron 2026-10-02, relayed by the Joyride session: 「BRT是宜昌/广州式的路权，站台在中央，专用道也在中央，总之请你好好研究，纳入人行道、自行车道、非机动车也就是电动车电鸡等慢行系统」; the data convention was agreed with the Joyride session the same day (internal/plans/BASIN-WORLD.zh-CN.md, 公交、快速公交与慢行)
avenue.comment: a Yichang- or Guangzhou-style avenue with its BRT in the centre: two road tiles side by side, one carriageway each way, the median and the BRT lanes on the drivers' left
avenue.valueMeans: the direction of travel on that half
avenue.partner: the tile on the driver's left, holding the opposite direction: north (1) -> x - 1, east (2) -> y - 1, south (4) -> x + 1, west (8) -> y + 1
avenue.command: build-path { network: "avenue", points }: one straight run, two tiles wide, from the first point toward the last (east-west unless the drag is longer north-south); the drag's row is the north half (its column the west half), pulled back one tile at the far map edge; the whole run is laid or nothing is
avenue.stampRules: road is laid where missing under a road's rules (bridges water; refused on zoned land, facilities and a step of more than one level, along each half and across each pair); a pair already this avenue is unchanged and free; a pair that is both halves of a crossing avenue is the junction and keeps them; a pair holding one half of another avenue is refused as occupied; a run with nothing to change is empty

capacity.rule: twice CONGESTION_THRESHOLD; the BRT lane carries no commuters and never congests

avenue.brtEffect: an avenue half congests at twice CONGESTION_THRESHOLD. A half inside a serving bus depot's eight tiles is served: its route cost is 3, its commuter flow is floor(traffic * 0.25) with no extra depot relief, and it is never marked congested. Halves outside that square keep the ordinary road cost. Avenue maintenance stays on the road divisor so a city with no served half keeps its save bytes
avenue.demolish: bulldozing either half takes its partner too and both are billed; an avenue never survives as a half
avenue.save: written only while a non-zero tile exists, so a city without an avenue keeps its save bytes and checkpoint; on load a present layer of the wrong length is refused, values outside 0, 1, 2, 4, 8 are cleared, and a half off the road or unanswered by its partner is cleared; SAVE_FORMAT_VERSION stays 5 because builds before ruleset 6 already refuse a ruleset-6 save
avenue.renderSnapshot: buildRenderSnapshot passes the layer through as avenue

exports.sc2: both halves export as road; the layer has no SC2K equivalent and is not carried; exportSc2 still returns bytes only, and sc2LossReport names the dropped layer so the shell can say so after a successful export
exports.micropolis: both halves export as road; the layer has no Micropolis equivalent and is not carried; every dropped half is counted in the loss report as layer-dropped-avenue

transitLines.decision: Aaron's Basin lane L4 (internal/plans/BASIN-WORLD.zh-CN.md, 翻盆): the planner draws, the mayor prices and pays, the city builds
transitLines.comment: the lines the mayor actually laid, written by Bonsai City after a flip-the-pot confirmation
transitLines.storage: optional payload sidecar `transitLines`: { version: 1, lines: [{ id, planId, name { zh, en }, color 0-6 or null, number 11-16 for a bus, mode ("metro" default, "brt", "bus"), vehicles 1-6, tiles [x, y, ...], stations [{ x, y, kind: "subway-station" | "station" | "bus-stop", name { zh, en }, group? }], laidTick }] }
transitLines.writtenWhen: only while the city holds at least one laid line; a city without one serializes byte for byte as it did before the field existed, and SAVE_FORMAT_VERSION stays 5
readBy: app/features/bonsai-renderer-canvas.js (the transit overlay, the stop signs, the buses)
app/features/bonsai-city.js (the tile balloon and the newspaper's 本市交通 box)
transitLines.invariant: a sidecar never changes a city number; every line in it was laid by the mayor's own commands, and the tiles it names are the city's own
transitLines.check: pot-world lines.check answers whether the city still holds what the sidecar says: rail or subway under every metro tile, road under every rubber-tyre tile, avenue under every BRT tile, the facility standing on every station, and a depot within reach of every rubber-tyre line
